svg.title: Choose beans using a remembered preference
svg.desc: Choose beans using a remembered preference I had a latte at coffee coffee coffee yesterday, but I can’t remember the menu name. You said it was nutty and sweet and you’d like it again. I haven’t confirmed the exact menu name. I’m almost out of coffee beans at home. I can look for a nutty taste like the latte you liked earlier. … Do you use a coffee machine or make pour-over at home? Real conversation · translated and condensed 2026-10-11

g.text: Choose beans using a remembered preference
I had a latte at coffee coffee coffee
yesterday, but I can’t remember the menu name.
You said it was nutty and sweet and you’d like it again. I
haven’t confirmed the exact menu name.
I’m almost out of coffee beans at home.
I can look for a nutty taste like the latte you liked earlier.
… Do you use a coffee machine or make pour-over at home?
